name: printtally
author: Ollie Hayman
description: Per-job print cost accounting for Canon imagePROGRAF printers

scripts.build:client: bun run --cwd ../web build && rm -rf dist/client && mkdir -p dist && cp -R ../web/dist dist/client
scripts.build: bun run build:client && bun build src/cli.ts --target bun --outfile dist/cli.js
scripts.build:binary: bun run build:client && bun build --compile --target bun-darwin-arm64 src/cli.ts --outfile dist/printtally-server
